model.name: audit.resolveArtifactViaSharedSource
model.description: PRIMARY (prevention): a gate and its runtime consumer resolve an artifact (list/config/bundle/version file) via ONE shared exported resolver -> gated-path and loaded-path CANNOT diverge by construction. NOT a same-named sibling, NOT a pre-build copy, NOT a differing default. First application = R40.34-L1 unifyLoadPath (revoked list; both check:revoked-tokens + server REVOKED_TOKENS_PATH resolve via it).
